title: Nourishing Turkish Fish Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Turkish fish stew featuring tender fish and earthy flavors, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This dish is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for those with sensitivities.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced carrots and zucchini and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the fish seasoning, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the diced tomatoes, cod fillets, and lemon juice to the pot.
Pour in enough water to cover the ingredients and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley or dill if desired.
Let the stew rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
